name: The Western Pylon
label: Quest
description: The Western Pylon: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My experiments so far have not yielded any positive results, friend. I can't help but hope that you can find a solution by searching for one of the pylons that I have heard exist.
Perhaps if we combine certain colors at them... But I get ahead of myself. Let's find them first!
Friend, search the western area of the crater; a pylon is said to be somewhere in that area.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you visited the pylon, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: There are many hidden areas of the crater along the sides. Try exploring the winding paths if you can't think of anywhere else to look, friend.
